name: file-card
title: File Card
description: A card component for displaying file state with thumbnail, progress, download, and actions.

docs.lead: A compound card component for displaying files with thumbnails, upload progress, download actions, error states, and remove actions. Supports document, image, video, and audio file types. Includes a high-level Item preset for quick rendering from file state.

examples.title: Upload States
examples.description: Uploading and failed states with progress bar, spinner, retry link, and action buttons.

examples.title: Completed Media Types
examples.description: Completed cards for document, image, video, and audio file types with appropriate thumbnails.
examples.code:
<FileCard.Root>
  <FileCard.Thumbnail>
    <FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" size="medium" />
  </FileCard.Thumbnail>
  <FileCard.Content>
    <FileCard.Body>
      <FileCard.Name>DataAnalysis.pdf</FileCard.Name>
      <FileCard.Meta>2.5 MB</FileCard.Meta>
      <FileCard.Hint>Uploaded on: June 5, 2023</FileCard.Hint>
    </FileCard.Body>
    <FileCard.Actions>
      <FileCard.RemoveButton />
    </FileCard.Actions>
  </FileCard.Content>
</FileCard.Root>

examples.title: Download
examples.description: Completed file cards with a download icon button action.

examples.title: Compact
examples.description: Compact variant showing uploading, completed, and failed states with inline layout.
examples.code:
<FileCard.CompactRoot>
  <FileCard.CompactContent>
    <FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" size="medium" />
    <FileCard.CompactBody>
      <FileCard.Name>my-cv.pdf</FileCard.Name>
      <FileCard.CompactDescription>
        <FileCard.Meta>0 KB of 120 KB</FileCard.Meta>
        <FileCard.Dot />
        <FileCard.CompactStatus status="uploading">Uploading...</FileCard.CompactStatus>
      </FileCard.CompactDescription>
    </FileCard.CompactBody>
    <FileCard.CloseButton />
  </FileCard.CompactContent>
  <FileCard.Progress value={10} />
</FileCard.CompactRoot>

examples.title: Item Preset
examples.description: High-level Item preset rendering uploading, failed, completed document, and completed image states automatically.
examples.code:
<FileCard.Item
  file={{ id: '1', name: 'DataAnalysis.pdf', size: 2621440, type: 'application/pdf', progress: 35, status: 'uploading' }}
  onClose={() => {}}
/>

examples.title: Item Preset: Download
examples.description: Item preset with download action for completed files.
examples.code:
<FileCard.Item
  file={{ id: '8', name: 'DataAnalysis.pdf', size: 2621440, type: 'application/pdf', progress: 100, status: 'completed' }}
  onDownload={() => {}}
/>

examples.title: Item Preset: Compact
examples.description: Item preset in compact variant showing uploading, completed, and failed states.
examples.code:
<FileCard.Item
  variant="compact"
  file={{ id: '5', name: 'my-cv.pdf', size: 122880, type: 'application/pdf', progress: 10, status: 'uploading' }}
  onClose={() => {}}
/>

api.name: FileCard.Item
api.description: A high-level preset that renders the correct card layout based on file status and variant. Reduces boilerplate by composing the compound sub-components internally.

props.name: file
props.type: { id: string; name: string; size: number; type: string; progress: number; status: 'pending' | 'uploading' | 'completed' | 'failed'; url?: string; preview?: string; error?: string }
props.description: The file state object. Compatible with useFileUpload hook's UploadFile type.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the remove/delete button is clicked.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the retry link is clicked (failed state only).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the close button is clicked (uploading state only).

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when the download button is clicked (completed state only).

api.name: FileCard.Root
api.description: The card container with rounded border and shadow.

api.name: FileCard.Thumbnail
api.description: Left-side thumbnail area (176x104px, gray background).

api.name: FileCard.Image
api.description: An image thumbnail that fills the thumbnail area.

api.name: FileCard.Video
api.description: A video thumbnail with a centered video icon overlay.

api.name: FileCard.Audio
api.description: An audio thumbnail with a speaker icon.

api.name: FileCard.Content
api.description: Right-side content area containing body and actions.

api.name: FileCard.Body
api.description: Stacks filename, meta, and hint vertically with gap-1 (4px). Use for completed states.

api.name: FileCard.UploadBody
api.description: Stacks info group and progress/retry vertically with gap-3 (12px). Use for uploading/failed states.

api.name: FileCard.InfoGroup
api.description: Groups name and status with gap-1.5 (6px). Use inside UploadBody.

api.name: FileCard.Name
api.description: The filename text (truncated).

api.name: FileCard.Meta
api.description: Secondary info like file size.

api.name: FileCard.Hint
api.description: Tertiary info like upload date or size recommendations.

api.name: FileCard.Status
api.description: Upload status indicator with icon.

props.name: status
props.description: The upload status. Shows a spinner for uploading, error icon for failed.

api.name: FileCard.Progress
api.description: A progress bar for upload progress.

api.name: FileCard.RemoveButton
api.description: A red outline button for removing the file.

api.name: FileCard.DownloadButton
api.description: A subtle download icon button for downloading files.

api.name: FileCard.CloseButton
api.description: A subtle close (x) button for canceling uploads.

api.name: FileCard.RetryLink
api.description: A red underlined link for retrying failed uploads.

api.name: FileCard.CompactRoot
api.description: Compact card container without thumbnail area. Supports error border.

props.name: error
props.description: When true, applies a red error border.

api.name: FileCard.CompactContent
api.description: Row layout for icon, text body, and action button.

api.name: FileCard.CompactBody
api.description: Stacks name and description vertically with gap-1.

api.name: FileCard.CompactErrorBody
api.description: Wraps CompactBody and RetryLink with gap-2. Use for failed states.

api.name: FileCard.CompactDescription
api.description: Inline row for meta, dot separator, and status.

api.name: FileCard.Dot
api.description: A dot separator for inline descriptions.

api.name: FileCard.CompactStatus
api.description: Status indicator with icon for compact variant.

props.name: status
props.description: The upload status. Shows spinner, checkmark, or error icon.

api.name: FileCard.DeleteButton
api.description: A subtle delete bin icon button for removing files.
